title: beautiful dish
text:
beautiful dish. I bought this a holiday serving dish. My sister-in-law loves a cranberry/orange/pineapple jello I make for Thanksgiving and I thought it would be beautiful in the footed bowl. It was well packed and arrived intact. The pineapple "carvings" are very smooth. The measurements are little different than listed, but it's close enough.
About 8 1/2" in diameter, about 4" deep. The foot portion is about 2" tall and the foot base diameter is about 4 1/2".
I don't think it looks like an "heirloom" piece, but it is perfect for my jello dish, a small triffle, some tangerines or persimmons.
Also to note: Because it is crystal, it should be handwashed in warm, soapy water and never placed in the dishwasher. Since I don't plan to use this dish every day, I don't consider that an issue.
Hope this info helps!
